set.body: Outcome: stop inferring scientific independence from unequal partition IDs. Acceptance: pairing builders consume an explicit source/design-level independence attestation and cannot mint one; crossnobis requires it; distinct IDs alone fail; reversal/ordered-edge laws remain; builders and tests use declaration terminology honestly; JVM and JS relational courts pass.
set.title: P7.1b: require explicit partition-independence attestation
